exactIssue: After AskRigor issue #150 cycle A passed, the worker posted the required immutable receipt and ended the owner-facing turn even though the same directive already specified the next local synthetic slice and no owner decision was missing.

relevantRule.section: 11. Continue automatically and keep the reasoning handoff live
relevantRule.excerpt: Reaching a directive stop or review boundary stops only further substantive execution under that directive. It does not authorize Codex to end the owner-facing loop after merely returning an execution receipt.

observedOrHypotheticalFailure: The phrase separate bounded directive was treated as a request for a new owner turn instead of a controller-owned reasoning handoff. Joel had to tell the worker to continue, repeating the owner-as-message-bus failure that the accepted executor-handoff-liveness design was intended to prevent.
proposedChange: Make queued-slice continuity explicit in the shared bootstrap and current-worker migration instruction, add EXECUTOR_CONTINUATION_DROPPED, and change the Mission Control worker projection from STOP_AND_RETURN_TO_REASONING_SUPERVISOR to a nonterminal route-await-resume state.

alternativesConsidered.alternative: Keep the current wording and rely on the owner to send continue
Let Codex cross every review boundary without a chat-authored directive

risks: Automatic continuation must not bypass a genuine owner decision, permission, spending, publication, destructive-action, or unavailable-reasoning boundary.
The worker UI must distinguish nonterminal review waiting from unauthorized continued execution.
workerRecommendation: Apply the already-accepted closed-loop handoff design consistently: keep later slices queued, have the controller obtain the next reasoning directive, and resume without owner relay unless a genuine owner decision is missing.
workerUncertainty: No new strategy is proposed. Pro meta-review should confirm whether EXECUTOR_CONTINUATION_DROPPED is best represented as a new alert code or an alias of EXECUTOR_HANDOFF_DROPPED.
decisionThatCanChange: The canonical alert vocabulary and the exact Mission Control projection for a receipt awaiting review while later authorized slices remain.
